text:
Today at #MSBuild we shared an early look at Project Solara, a new platform for agent-first devices.

We’re exploring how agents can take shape in devices designed for a specific scenario, customer, or place—bringing intelligence into workflows and environments where traditional computing has not naturally fit before.

Project Solara is the platform that lets builders realize this vision for their customers—choosing where their agents should live, what form they should take, and what new work they can unlock.

It’s still early, but the opportunity is exciting! Read more at https://t.co/C7XIYFOwd3.
